title: Step 2 - Mastering Regression Model Visualization: Increasing Data Resolution

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: And now, the last thing that I'm gonna do is maybe to take this code section here.
cues.zh: 最後，我可能會把這段程式碼取出來。

cues.en: Cut.
cues.zh: 剪下。

cues.en: And I'm actually going to place it between the creation of the model and the visualization because I like to keep the best for the end.
cues.zh: 放在建立模型與視覺化之間，因為我喜歡把最精彩的留到最後。

cues.en: And for me, the best part, the most exciting part, is the part where we visualize our results.
cues.zh: 對我而言，最棒、最令人興奮的，就是將結果視覺化的部分。

cues.en: And for a second reason, is that we know that our problem is a non-linear problem, and that therefore we need a non-linear regressor.
cues.zh: 另一個原因是，我們已經知道這個問題是非線性問題，因此需要非線性迴歸器。

cues.en: And we're definitely already convinced of that.
cues.zh: 對此我們已經完全信服。

cues.en: So that's why we don't need to execute this code section before this one to convince ourself that we need indeed a non-linear regression model.
cues.zh: 所以不必先執行這個區段，再執行這個區段，來說服自己確實需要非線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: So therefore, for the next regression models, we'll make the prediction before visualizing the results.
cues.zh: 因此，接下來的迴歸模型會先預測，再視覺化結果。

cues.en: And that's why I'm putting that here first.
cues.zh: 這就是我先把它放在這裡的原因。

cues.en: Okay, so I think the template is ready now.
cues.zh: 好，我想範本現在準備好了。

cues.en: Well, maybe we need to change the Polynomial here to generalize the template as much as possible.
cues.zh: 或許還需要把這裡的 Polynomial 改掉，讓範本盡可能通用。

cues.en: So, we'll replace Polynomial here by, well actually, let's just put Predicting a new result.
cues.zh: 所以把這裡的 Polynomial 換成，嗯，直接寫「Predicting a new result」，預測新的結果。

cues.en: All right, and here we can replace Polynomial Regression by Regression Model.
cues.zh: 好，這裡也把 Polynomial Regression 改成 Regression Model。

cues.en: Alright, and now, just to finish this template, for those of you who are also interested in getting a smoother curve in your regression model results, well, there is this trick we can do
cues.zh: 最後，對於也想在迴歸模型結果中得到更平滑曲線的人，有一個技巧，

cues.en: to increase the resolution, and we are gonna do that right now.
cues.zh: 可以提高解析度，我們現在就來做。

cues.en: So it's just an optional code section that I'm adding here in this template.
cues.zh: 這只是額外加入範本的一個選用程式碼區段。

cues.en: I'm gonna copy this, because we will have just a few things to change.
cues.zh: 先複製這一段，因為只需要修改少數地方。

cues.en: And you know, for those of you who really want a very smooth curve when you visualize the regression model results, well, you can use the following code.
cues.zh: 如果你希望視覺化迴歸模型結果時，曲線非常平滑，就可以使用接下來這段程式碼。

cues.en: So the trick is to actually create a new sequence of levels.
cues.zh: 技巧是建立新的職位等級序列。

cues.en: That means that here, when we are predicting only 10 salaries of the 10 levels, well, what we're gonna do now in this section is that instead of predicting only 10 salaries of 10 levels,
cues.zh: 也就是原本這裡只預測 10 個等級的 10 筆薪資，而現在這個區段不再只預測這 10 筆，

cues.en: we're gonna predict a lot more than 10 levels.
cues.zh: 而是預測遠超過 10 個等級的薪資。

cues.en: And to do that, we will build a vector of imaginary levels that will actually be levels from one to 10, incremented by 0.1.
cues.zh: 做法是建立一個假想等級向量，從 1 到 10，每次增加 0.1。

cues.en: So that means I will consider level 1, level 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, up to 9.6, 9.7, 9.8, and 9.9.
So that's what we'll create in this sequence.
cues.zh: 這就是這個序列要建立的內容。

cues.en: And therefore, here, instead of predicting only 10 salaries, we will predict actually 90 salaries of 90 levels.
cues.zh: 因此這裡不再只預測 10 筆薪資，而會預測 90 個等級的 90 筆薪資。

cues.en: So that's the trick.
cues.zh: 這就是技巧。

cues.en: And to build this sequence, it's actually very simple.
cues.zh: 建立這個序列其實很簡單。

cues.en: We're gonna call this sequence x grid, you know, because x grid will replace dataset$Level here and dataset here.
cues.zh: 將這個序列命名為 x_grid，因為它會取代這裡的 dataset$Level，以及這裡的 dataset。

cues.en: And this x grid is going to be defined as seq, which is a function that builds a sequence.
cues.zh: x_grid 定義為 seq 的結果，seq 是建立序列的函式。

cues.en: And so, in this function, we need to input three parameters: the lower bound of your sequence.
cues.zh: 這個函式需要輸入三個參數：首先是序列的下界。

cues.en: So that's actually min dataset level, because by doing this, we're taking the minimum of all the levels in your original dataset.
cues.zh: 也就是 min(dataset$Level)，這樣就能取得原始資料集中所有職位等級的最小值。

cues.en: All right, then the next parameter is the upper bound of your levels, that is level 10.
cues.zh: 接著的參數是職位等級的上界，也就是第 10 級。

cues.en: And therefore, we do the same with the max here, max dataset$Level.
cues.zh: 因此同樣使用 max，寫成 max(dataset$Level)。

cues.en: All right, and the third parameter is the step.
cues.zh: 第三個參數是步長。

cues.en: So that's where we increase the resolution and make our fitting curve smoother, because here we're gonna take a step of 0.1, and therefore 90 levels will be created here,
cues.zh: 這裡就是提高解析度、讓擬合曲線更平滑的關鍵。我們使用 0.1 的步長，因此講者這裡說會建立 90 個等級，

cues.en: from one to 10, incremented by 0.1.
cues.zh: 範圍從 1 到 10，每次增加 0.1。

cues.en: All right, that's actually done.
cues.zh: 好，這樣就完成了。

cues.en: And now we need to replace dataset$Level here, that originally took the 10 levels of our dataset.
cues.zh: 現在要替換這裡原本取得資料集 10 個等級的 dataset$Level。

cues.en: So we are replacing that by x grid.
cues.zh: 把它換成 x_grid。

cues.en: And same here.
cues.zh: 這裡也是一樣。

cues.en: We need to replace dataset here by a new data frame because, you know, this new data argument here is expecting a data frame here.
cues.zh: 要把 dataset 換成新的資料框，因為這裡的 newdata 參數，預期接收的是資料框。

cues.en: So we cannot replace it directly by x grid here because x grid is not a data frame, it's a sequence that is, it's a vector.
cues.zh: 不能直接用 x_grid 替換，因為 x_grid 不是資料框，而是一個序列，也就是向量。

cues.en: So what we need to do here is use this little trick again, but don't worry, it's quite simple.
cues.zh: 所以需要再次使用這個小技巧，別擔心，很簡單。

cues.en: We need to use this data.frame command here.
cues.zh: 使用 data.frame 這個指令。

cues.en: That will actually create a data frame.
cues.zh: 它會建立資料框。

cues.en: And in parenthesis, we're gonna specify that we want to create a data frame of new levels.
cues.zh: 在括號裡指定，要建立一個包含新職位等級的資料框。

cues.en: So I'm taking the variable level here, and then equals, and that's where you put x grid, because you know, by doing this data frame level equals x grid,
cues.zh: 先寫變數 Level，再加上等號，接著放入 x_grid。透過 data.frame(Level = x_grid)，

cues.en: we are just creating a new column of levels containing all the levels in this sequence, x grid, here of levels.
cues.zh: 就是建立一個新的 Level 欄，包含這個 x_grid 序列裡所有的職位等級。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: This new code section is ready to plot your regression model results in higher resolution.
cues.zh: 這個新的程式碼區段，已經可以用更高解析度來畫出迴歸模型結果。

cues.en: And actually, we're gonna specify here that it's for higher resolution and smoother curve.
cues.zh: 我們在這裡註明，這是用來提高解析度、讓曲線更平滑的。

cues.en: All right, and that's actually ready.
cues.zh: 好，都準備好了。

cues.en: So you can try it on either, you know, your polynomial regression model that we made in this section, or you can use it on the future non-linear regression models that we're about to build.
cues.zh: 可以將它用在本節建立的多項式迴歸模型，也可以用在接下來要建立的非線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: And you will see the difference between these two.
cues.zh: 你會看到兩種方式的差異。

cues.en: But then, if you want a more simple code, you can use this one.
cues.zh: 如果想要更簡單的程式碼，就使用這一段。

cues.en: Or if you have, for example, a dataset with a hundred observations incremented by one, then this is the code you need to execute.
cues.zh: 或者資料集有 100 筆觀測資料、每筆間隔為 1，也可以執行這一段程式碼。

cues.en: Because then you wouldn't need a 0.1 step to build your different points of your fitting curve.
cues.zh: 因為這樣就不需要用 0.1 的步長，來建立擬合曲線的各個點。

cues.en: Alright, so now the template is ready.
cues.zh: 好，現在範本準備完成。

cues.en: We're actually ready to use it for the next non-linear regression models that we're about to build.
cues.zh: 我們可以把它用在接下來要建立的非線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: We'll do that in the next sections, and you're gonna see how we'll be so efficient at building them.
cues.zh: 下一些章節就會這麼做，你也會看到建立模型的效率有多高。
